flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: Only scaffolding in ocmsadminui: utils/Meta/System.ts (path/title), utils/mapping/SystemAdmin.ts (COMPLAINANT_CODE mapping), utils/validation/Format/ValidFile.ts (file rules), utils/models/{Fsystemadmin,Fapi,Icourtcase,Icsdbatch}.d.ts (types). No route, page, menu, controller, entity or cron. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no complainant code.
note: The story (1 point) asks OCMS to prompt when a signature upload succeeds. Because the signature upload feature itself is not in the code (see OCMS23.2), no upload can succeed and there is no prompt. Only unwired placeholders exist in ocmsadminui. No related maintenance ticket. The 'Fully paid' status is not supported by code in the repos (cannot verify from repo whether it was built outside these six repos).
recommendation: Do not claim as done based on code; depends on OCMS23.2. Ask URA/the team to confirm or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: Officer uploads the complainant signature through OCMS
steps.detail: There is no signature upload component; ValidFile.ts:177-180 is a file rule that nobody calls. No entity, repository, controller or SQL named complainant / signature / oic_signature exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep over src, 0 relevant hits; the stale ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice copy was ignored).

steps.step: OCMS determines whether the signature upload succeeded or failed
steps.detail: There is no signature upload response handler because there is no upload and no endpoint. System.ts:183-186 is only the title 'Complainant Signature' with a null path (System.ts:61), with no route. No entity, repository, controller or SQL named complainant / signature / oic_signature exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep over src, 0 relevant hits; the stale ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice copy was ignored).

steps.step: OCMS shows a success prompt/message to the officer
steps.detail: There is no success prompt or message specific to signature upload. Generic success messages on other System Admin pages are not connected to signature, so they are not counted. No related maintenance ticket.
